_meta.name: sem-ordinal-score
_meta.description: Per-row latent scores from an ordinal structural equation model on brand_survey.pulse via ATTR_SEM_SCORE: the three-factor CFA (quality =~ q1 + q2 + q3, value =~ v1 + v2 + v3, service =~ s1 + s2 + s3) fitted inline as MAT_SEM's estimator wlsmv with the nine 1-5 ratings ordered, jointly across the two waves (params.group wave) with thresholds, loadings and intercepts held equal (group_equal). On an ordinal fit method regression means lavaan's empirical Bayes modal (EBM) scores: each row's most likely latent value given its rating categories and its own wave's parameters, on one latent-mean scale (wave1, the reference, at 0). Averaged by wave, value_score falls and service_score rises in wave2, the shift the matrix example matrices/18_sem_ordinal.json reports as latent means. A rating value the fit never saw would score null with PULSE_SEM_SCORE_LEVEL_UNSEEN. The fit is cohort-wide, never per request group; the ordinal fit and the grouping run the request buffered.
